overview_description.description:
The Teleport Infrastructure Identity Platform modernizes identity, access, and policy for infrastructure, for both human and non-human identities, improving engineering velocity and resiliency of critical infrastructure against human factors and/or compromise.    

Teleport is purpose-built for infrastructure use cases and implements trusted computing at scale, with unified cryptographic identities for humans, machines and workloads, endpoints, infrastructure assets, and AI agents. The company's identity-everywhere approach vertically integrates access management, zero trust networking, identity governance, and identity security into a single platform, eliminating overhead and operational silos.

about_short_description.short_description: Teleport is an infrastructure identity company provides access to infrastructure on a foundation of cryptographic identity and zero trust.

product.name: Teleport Infrastructure Identity Platform
product.description: A platform for managing cryptographic identity and zero-trust access for human users, machines, workloads, and AI agents across servers, databases, applications, desktops, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.

product.name: Teleport Beams
product.description: An ephemeral runtime for AI agents that provisions isolated microVMs with Teleport-issued identities, controlled infrastructure access, and audited actions without storing static secrets or API keys.

product.name: Teleport Community Edition
product.description: An Apache-2.0-licensed open-source edition for providing secure infrastructure access, identity-based authentication, role-based access control, and session auditing.
